tools.description: Estimate market beta from supplied asset and benchmark return observations. Return the runtime's measure of sensitivity to benchmark movements. Supply the operation inputs in args. Uses your existing MUSITU Axiom account entitlement and records compute-unit usage.

tools.name: axiom_finance_drawdown
tools.title: MUSITU Axiom: finance.drawdown
tools.description: Analyze declines from prior peaks in a supplied value or return series. Return the drawdown measures reported for that data. Supply the operation inputs in args. Uses your existing MUSITU Axiom account entitlement and records compute-unit usage.

tools.name: axiom_finance_monte_carlo_gbm
tools.title: MUSITU Axiom: finance.monte_carlo_gbm
tools.description: Simulate asset-price scenarios using geometric Brownian motion and supplied model assumptions. Return scenario outputs; simulations are not market forecasts. Supply the operation inputs in args. Uses your existing MUSITU Axiom account entitlement and records compute-unit usage.

tools.name: axiom_timeseries_rolling_volatility
tools.title: MUSITU Axiom: timeseries.rolling_volatility
tools.description: Estimate volatility over rolling windows of a supplied series for time-series analysis. Return the rolling risk measure for the requested window settings. Supply the operation inputs in args. Uses your existing MUSITU Axiom account entitlement and records compute-unit usage.

tools.name: axiom_geometry_area_circle
tools.title: MUSITU Axiom: geometry.area_circle
tools.description: Calculate the area of a circle from a supplied radius. Return the numerical area for the supplied units and assumptions. Supply the operation inputs in args. Uses your existing MUSITU Axiom account entitlement and records compute-unit usage.

tools.name: axiom_geometry_volume_sphere
tools.title: MUSITU Axiom: geometry.volume_sphere
tools.description: Calculate the volume of a sphere from a supplied radius. Return the numerical volume for the supplied units and assumptions. Supply the operation inputs in args. Uses your existing MUSITU Axiom account entitlement and records compute-unit usage.

tools.name: axiom_transforms_ifft
tools.title: MUSITU Axiom: transforms.ifft
tools.description: Compute the inverse discrete Fourier transform of supplied frequency-domain values. Return the reconstructed numerical samples. Supply the operation inputs in args. Uses your existing MUSITU Axiom account entitlement and records compute-unit usage.

tools.name: axiom_verify_crosscheck
tools.title: MUSITU Axiom: verify.crosscheck
tools.description: Cross-check supplied numerical expressions or results and return the runtime's comparison output. Read the comparison status before treating outputs as agreeing. Supply the operation inputs in args. Uses your existing MUSITU Axiom account entitlement and records compute-unit usage.
